description:
Job Description:- 
 Must have Java (core Java with mandatory on Servlets, Filters), JS, JQuery, HTML5, CSS competencies. 
 Competency in Angular.JS 1.5 or above is a must 
 Expertise in micro services , Spring boot, app memory management, multithreading, networking & Security 
 Should have good competency in hybrid apps with some experience in native app design and development (Android and iOS). The Dev lead won’t be writing native app code, but they will be interfacing with the team that does, hence some experience may be beneficial. 
 Candidate should also be able to demonstrate high competency in OAuth 
 Experience in leading a small group of team members 
 Solid understanding of software design and patterns like - MVC, Delegation, Singleton, Factory, Adapter 
 Familiarity with agile development/waterfall processes and methodologies 
 Ability to work in team environment and client interfacing skills. 
 Analytical skills 
 

 Basic Qualifications :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 
 **  U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply .  We are unable to sponsor at this time. 
 Note:- 
 This is a Full-Time Permanent  job opportunity for you.
 Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder, TN Visa, GC-EAD ,  H4-EAD & L2-EAD can apply. 
 No OPT-EAD & H1B Consultants please.
 
 Please mention your  Visa Status  in your  email   or  resume .
